title: Re-review Phase 1 Pre-commitment Artifact
description: Phase 1 (revision-blind) criteria-commitment artifact of the #576 Spec B three-gate re-review contract. One PrecommitmentRecord per Priority 1 (must_fix) and Priority 2 (should_fix) Schema 7 roadmap item; Priority 3 (consider) items get NO record (spec §3.2/§5.1). Each record OPERATIONALIZES the inherited author-visible criterion (Schema 7 verification_criteria + decision-letter Acceptance criteria) — it never invents a new yardstick; post-revision new standards go to new_standards[] as NewStandardRecord, advisory by default. Hash-bound to the §11 input manifest via input_manifest_hash; scripts/check_re_review_synthesis.py recomputes every binding. Spec: docs/design/2026-07-27-576-spec-b-re-review-precommitment-contract-spec.md §5.1.

contract_version.description: Frozen contract-family version for the v1 three-gate contract (equivalence_policy is likewise constant in v1).

round_id.description: Re-review round identifier; MUST equal the round_id of the §11 input manifest and of the Phase 2A/2B artifacts (checker-enforced).

input_manifest_hash.description: sha256 hex over the §11 input manifest's JSON Canonical Form (RFC 8785 / JCS, the v3.6.3 passport hashing convention). First link of the §11 hash chain; the checker recomputes it.

items.description: Exactly one record per must_fix/should_fix roadmap item (checker-enforced against the hash-bound roadmap). consider items carry no record.

new_standards.description: Acceptance requirements beyond the inherited criterion (SD-2 boundary). Advisory by default; escalation_requested entries are only requests — substantiation happens at Phase 2A via EscalationExceptionRecord.new_standard_ref.

item_id.description: Schema 7 RoadmapItem id (e.g. REV-001, forward-seeded REV-PM-1). The join key every §13 invariant uses.

priority.description: consider items get no pre-commitment record (§3.2), so the priority set here is closed at P1/P2.

roadmap_text.description: VERBATIM copy of the Schema 7 item's verification_criteria (level-1 yardstick). The checker byte-compares it against the hash-bound roadmap.

letter_text.description: VERBATIM copy of the decision letter's Acceptance-criteria text at the item's derived R<n> block (level-2 yardstick). must_fix items only; biconditional with letter_item_ref.

letter_item_ref.description: DERIVED, never chosen: R<n> <=> the roadmap's nth must_fix item in roadmap order (§5.1). Checker recomputes the ordinal, uniqueness, and must_fix-only compatibility.

fully_addressed.description: The concrete manuscript evidence pattern that satisfies the inherited criterion (not "the author says so").

partially_addressed.description: What a genuine-but-incomplete fix looks like. must_fix items only — P2 lighter form derives PARTIALLY_ADDRESSED on-criterion from the committed fully_addressed pattern (§5.1).

made_worse_discriminator.description: What distinguishes a regression on this item. must_fix items only — P2 uses the protocol-level generic discriminator (§5.1).

expected_change_surface.description: Where the fix is EXPECTED to manifest. Navigation hypothesis only (SD-10): an equivalent fix elsewhere that satisfies fully_addressed counts; a cosmetic edit at this location does not.

equivalence_policy.description: Constant in v1: equivalent fixes and evidence-backed disagreement are admissible (SD-10).

source_reviewer.description: VERBATIM copy of the Schema 7 item's required reviewer field (free-text string, e.g. "R1, R3"). No new Schema 7 fields exist.

source_reviewer_labels.description: Produced by the §10 normalization grammar (strip parentheticals, then em-dash tails, split, trim, case-fold, whole-token exact match; unrecognized tokens dropped). Possibly empty. The checker recomputes it from source_reviewer and requires equality.

new_standard_id.description: Unique id within the artifact; the target of EscalationExceptionRecord.new_standard_ref (§5.2).

classification.description: escalation_requested is only a REQUEST — the substantiating EscalationExceptionRecord is created at Phase 2A; a request never substantiated at 2A lapses to advisory (§5.1).
